package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/examples/article/models"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

var _ orm.ModelDescriptor[models.Article] = models.ArticleDescriptor{}

func BuildArticleQuery(backend db.Queryer) (orm.QuerySet[models.Article], error) {
	search := orm.Or(
		models.ArticleFields.Title.IContains("django"),
		models.ArticleFields.Summary.IContains("django"),
	)
	visibility := orm.And(
		models.ArticleFields.Published.Exact(true),
		orm.Not(models.ArticleFields.Title.IContains("draft")),
	)
	advanced := orm.And(
		models.ArticleFields.ID.GreaterThanOrEqual(1),
		models.ArticleFields.ID.LessThanOrEqual(100),
		models.ArticleFields.Title.ExactField(orm.F(models.ArticleFields.Summary)),
	)
	querySet := models.ArticleObjects.Using(backend).
		Filter(search, visibility, advanced).
		OrderBy(models.ArticleFields.ID.Desc())
	return querySet.Limit(2)
}

func ExerciseArticleTerminalTypes(ctx context.Context, backend db.Queryer) error {
	querySet, err := BuildArticleQuery(backend)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	var fresh func() orm.QuerySet[models.Article] = querySet.Fresh
	var all func(context.Context) ([]models.Article, error) = querySet.All
	var count func(context.Context) (int64, error) = querySet.Count
	var exists func(context.Context) (bool, error) = querySet.Exists
	var at func(context.Context, int) (models.Article, bool, error) = querySet.At
	var first func(context.Context) (models.Article, bool, error) = querySet.First
	var iterate func(context.Context, func(models.Article) error) error = querySet.Iterate

	freshQuerySet := fresh()
	var exactQuerySet orm.QuerySet[models.Article] = freshQuerySet
	_ = exactQuerySet

	articles, err := all(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var exactArticles []models.Article = articles
	_ = exactArticles

	articleCount, err := count(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var exactCount int64 = articleCount
	_ = exactCount

	articleExists, err := exists(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var exactExists bool = articleExists
	_ = exactExists

	article, found, err := at(ctx, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var exactArticle models.Article = article
	var exactFound bool = found
	_, _ = exactArticle, exactFound

	article, found, err = first(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	exactArticle, exactFound = article, found

	return iterate(ctx, func(value models.Article) error {
		var exactValue models.Article = value
		_ = exactValue
		return nil
	})
}
